{{Spoiler}}

'''Pickled crimson fungus''' is the secret preservation of the [[crimson fungus]]: a splash potion of {{EffectLink|Weakness}} II lasting 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_crimson_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Crimson fungus, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret; making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''

== Usage ==

=== Throwing ===
It can't be eaten. Like a splash potion, it is thrown and applies Weakness II for up to 1:00 to every creature in the splash, at full duration for a direct hit and shorter further out. The tooltip marks it as throwable.
